info.description: Unified API for agents, chat, logs, and files. Authenticate with POST /auth/login, then send the token in the Authorization header.
info.title: Myaaw Control Plane API

get.description: Returns every initialized agent with its default flag, running state, port, and base URL.
Effective policy (config.json merged with defaults) plus the runtime grants from config/approvals.json. Read-only.

delete.description: Empties config/approvals.json. The policy in config.json is untouched.
Removes the key from config/approvals.json (all scopes), or only the scopes matching the optional channel/user filters.

parameters.description: Only revoke grants for this channel
parameters.name: channel

parameters.description: Only revoke grants for this user id
parameters.name: user

delete.description: Removes only the given conversation from the key's session grants.

post.description: Forwards the decision to the agent that owns the pending run.
Proxies to the agent server. user_id defaults to the authenticated control-plane user when omitted or 0.

get.description: Folders are scoped to the authenticated user (or the user_id query).

post.description: Names are trimmed, unique per user ignoring case, and limited to 64 characters. A user may keep up to 100 folders.

delete.description: Removes the folder and its conversations in one transaction. deleted_ids lets a client leave an open transcript.

get.description: Streams the events of a running (or recently finished) run, replaying everything after `after`. The run keeps going when this connection drops.
Lists the runs of the agent, newest first. Finished runs stay listed for a while so a reloaded tab can still replay their tail.

post.description: Cancels the run started with the same request_id. The partial transcript is kept and the run stops spending provider tokens.
Relays the agent's Server-Sent Events (thought, chunk, tool, tool_result, done, error). user_id defaults to the authenticated control-plane user when omitted or 0.

patch.summary: Reset specific config fields to defaults

get.description: Contacts live in ~/.myaaw/agents/<agent>/contacts.json and reference other A2A agents.

post.description: The token is the bearer token issued by the remote agent. It is stored in contacts.json and masked on output.

patch.description: Omitted fields keep their value. A non-empty token replaces the stored one; clear_token removes it.

get.description: Returns the allowed core Markdown files and every .md file under memory/. Other .md files are never listed.
Reads an allowed core Markdown file or any .md file under memory/.

put.description: Writes an allowed core Markdown file or any .md file under memory/. Parent directories under memory/ are created automatically.

get.description: Conversations are scoped to the authenticated user unless user_id is provided. search matches the title only.

parameters.description: User ID (defaults to the authenticated user)
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Only Recents: not pinned and not in a folder
parameters.name: unfiled

parameters.description: Only conversations in this folder id
parameters.name: folder

get.description: Per-day count of conversations created by the authenticated user. Defaults to the current month.

parameters.description: Window start, unix milliseconds (default: first day of this month)
parameters.name: from

get.description: Returns 403 when the conversation belongs to another user.

parameters.description: User ID (defaults to the authenticated user)
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Message offset (default 0, negative starts from the end)
parameters.name: offset

delete.description: Only the owner can delete a conversation.

parameters.description: User ID (defaults to the authenticated user)
parameters.name: user_id

patch.description: Only the owner can rename a conversation. Titles are trimmed and must not be empty.

parameters.description: User ID (defaults to the authenticated user)
parameters.name: user_id

put.description: folder_id must belong to the same user; null moves the chat out of its folder.
Pinning sets pinned_at to now; unpinning clears it. It never changes updated_at.

post.description: Stores the read watermark shared by every device. `at` is optional (RFC3339); omitted means now. The value never moves backwards and is clamped to the conversation's own updated_at.

parameters.description: User ID (defaults to the authenticated user)
parameters.name: user_id

get.description: Server-Sent Events: a `conversation.updated` event is emitted when a cron, heartbeat, or sub-agent turn lands. The client re-reads the transcript.
Lists the virtual roots (/home, /user, /skills, /jobs) or the entries of one directory.
Serves the raw bytes with the extension's content type and range support. Pass download=1 to force a save dialog.

post.summary: Rename or move an agent path

get.description: Sends existing lines, then new lines as they are written. Events: ready, line.

parameters.description: Filter by trigger: user, cron, subagent, or a2a
parameters.name: trigger

parameters.description: Delete runs started before this unix ms
parameters.name: before

post.description: Requires loopback peer/host and local browser Origin/Referer, including through the frontend proxy. Authorization URLs are sensitive; never log them. The agent name may be new and is not persisted.

parameters.description: Optional saved or pending credential ID
parameters.name: request

get.description: Requires same-machine access; browser GET requests without Origin need a local Referer. Status includes only pending/connected/failed/expired, credential_id, email, and sanitized error. Never includes tokens or authorization URLs.

post.description: Clears only this provider's credential reference. Does not delete shared host credentials or revoke the remote ChatGPT grant.

get.summary: List models for a saved provider

get.description: Reads the skills directory fresh from disk. Enabled state follows skills.json, then the SKILL.md frontmatter, then defaults to enabled.
Includes the SKILL.md content and every file in the skill directory (scripts, images, nested folders). A stale skills.json key for a deleted folder is removed automatically.

delete.description: Removes the skill folder recursively. Changes made through the terminal are reflected automatically.

patch.description: Writes the skill's flag to skills.json. The agent picks up the change on the next conversation without a restart.

delete.description: Removes the skill's skills.json key so the enabled state falls back to the SKILL.md frontmatter or the default. The skill folder is untouched; a missing key is not an error.
delete.summary: Reset a skill to its default state

get.description: Text files return as plain text; binary files (images, compiled scripts) return base64 with binary:true. Paths are relative to the skill directory and cannot escape it.

parameters.description: File path relative to the skill
parameters.name: path

post.description: Copies the embedded template into the agent's skills directory and records it as enabled in skills.json. An existing folder is never overwritten, so the call is idempotent.
Runs a real PTY on the API host, in the agent's home directory. Disabled unless the API was started with MYAAW_TERMINAL=1 (myaaw api restart --terminal).
Refreshes the idle clock. A session is reaped after two minutes without input, resize, or heartbeat.

get.description: Built-in tools are the canonical set. Custom tools and MCP servers come only from tools.json; files inside the tools directory are storage, not active tools.

patch.description: Built-in tools can only be toggled, never deleted. Accepted names: bash, filesystem, cron, execute_python (alias python), provider, subagent.
patch.summary: Enable or disable a built-in tool

post.description: Registers a command as a custom tool. The command may live anywhere; storing it under the tools folder does not activate it until it is added here.

delete.description: Removes the tools.json entry only; files in the tools directory are never touched.

patch.description: Updates enabled, command, args, or schema. Only provided fields change; schema null removes an inline schema.

post.description: Registers an stdio MCP server. Env values are accepted on input and masked on output.

delete.description: Removes the tools.json entry only; a running server process stops on the next agent server reload or restart.

patch.description: Updates enabled, command, args, or env. A provided env map replaces the previous one entirely.

post.description: Authenticate with username and password and receive a bearer token.

get.description: Returns the control-plane username and the agent user ID that conversation and chat requests default to.

post.description: Writes a tar.gz archive per agent into the backup directory. An empty agent list backs up every initialized agent and adds the global registry.
Stops the agent if it is running, then rewrites its directory from the archive. force replaces an agent that already exists.

get.description: Reads the template embedded in the binary, including SKILL.md and every file in it. Nothing is written to the agent.
Text files return as plain text; binary files return base64 with binary:true. Paths are relative to the template directory.

parameters.description: File path relative to the skill directory
parameters.name: path

args.description: Args carries the full argument JSON of an approval item.

attempt.description: Retry and compaction details, set on their own kinds.

subagent.description: SubAgent names the sub-agent that raised an approval item, if any.

redact_patterns.description:
RedactPatterns masks secrets in stored content. Nil keeps the built-in
patterns; a pointer to an empty list disables redaction.

retention_days.description:
RetentionDays drops runs older than this when the database opens. Nil
keeps the default; an explicit 0 keeps everything.

chat_type.description:
ChatType distinguishes a Discord DM from a guild channel ("dm" vs
"guild"). Telegram derives it from the sign of To.

session_id.description: SessionID pins the exact conversation (required for api/cli targets).

thread_id.description: ThreadID is the Telegram message_thread_id for a forum topic.

to.description: user id (dm/api/cli), chat id (telegram), channel id (discord)

name.description:
Snapshot of the job at run time. One-time jobs are removed after they
run, so without this the history could not name the job or say what it
delivered. Older lines simply have these fields empty.

Snapshot of the job at run time. One-time jobs are removed after they
run, so without this the history could not name the job or say what it
delivered. Older lines simply have these fields empty.

request_id.description: RequestID lets the client stop this run with POST /agents/{name}/chat/stop.

at.description: At is the newest turn being acknowledged, as RFC3339. Omitted means now.

priced.description:
Priced is false when at least one call spent tokens without recording a
cost — usually a missing price entry, sometimes a call recorded before the
entry existed.

parent_run_id.description:
ParentRunID and ParentSpanID link a nested run (a subagent) into the
trace that started it.

tool_cost_usd.description:
ToolCostUSD is what the tool calls of this run cost at the configured
per-call prices. It is kept apart from ModelCostUSD on purpose.

trigger.description:
Trigger says what started the run: a user message ("user"), a cron job
("cron"), or a subagent ("subagent"). Heartbeats are not recorded.

cost_complete.description: CostComplete is false when a turn in the session used an unpriced model.

cache_hit_tokens.description: CacheHitTokens is the part of InputTokens served from the prompt cache.

llm_ms.description:
LlmMs and ToolMs are the wall time spent in provider requests and tool
executions across the session. TtftMs is the mean first-token latency of
the requests that streamed a first token.

provider.description: Provider is the provider type of the newest run, Model its model.

tok_per_sec.description: TokPerSec is the generation throughput of the newest run.

total_tokens.description:
TotalTokens is input + output. UncachedInputTokens is InputTokens minus
the cache hits, and CacheHitRate is the rounded share served from cache.
They are computed here so clients never re-derive the arithmetic.

cost_complete.description:
CostComplete is false when at least one run used a model with no price,
so CostUSD is a lower bound rather than the full spend.

database_bytes.description:
DatabaseBytes is the size of the trace database on disk, including its
write-ahead log. It makes growth visible without shelling out to du.

tool_cost_usd.description: ToolCostUSD is spend on priced tool calls, separate from model tokens.

created_at.description:
CreatedAt is when the message entered the transcript, stored in UTC. A nil
timestamp means the message predates per-message times.

id.description:
ID is the stable transcript-entry id, used to address the files a user
uploaded with that message.

provider_metadata.description:
ProviderMetadata holds opaque continuation state, not displayable reasoning.
Preserve it when persisting or copying assistant turns. Other providers
deliberately do not serialize this field onto their wire requests.

sender_id.description:
Sender metadata for messages that arrive from a shared chat (a group or a
forum topic). These fields are display-only and are not sent to providers;
the model learns who is speaking from the <userinfo> block at the top of
the message content instead.

thought.description: ReAct Trace Fields (UI metadata; not sent to providers)

trace.description: Trace stores all ReAct steps as JSON array for final response

cached_input_tokens.description:
CachedInputTokens is the share of PromptTokens served from the provider
prompt cache. Providers that do not report it leave it at zero.

agent_color.description:
AgentColor is always resolved: an agent registered before colours existed
reads back as the palette default, so clients never have to know it.

agents.description: Agents is empty to back up every initialized agent.

scope.description: Scope identifies the chat target (see ConversationSummary.Scope).

turns.description:
Turns covers the whole conversation, not only the returned messages, because
the client draws one tick per question. It is not paginated: every detail
response carries the full list. If improvement is needed (thousands of turns,
or a payload that starts to hurt), either ship the indexes only and fetch
labels per window, cap the list with a `turns_truncated` flag, or lower
turnTextLimit.

channel.description:
Channel is the platform that owns the session (telegram, discord, api,
cli). Empty for sessions created before the column existed.

chat_name.description:
ChatName/TopicName are display names learned from the channel (group name
and forum topic). Empty for CLI/API/DM sessions and unknown scopes.

scope.description:
Scope identifies the chat target the session belongs to, e.g. a Telegram
topic ("tg:<chatID>:<threadID>"). Empty for CLI/API/DM sessions, so
clients that do not know the field keep working unchanged.

index.description: Index is the position of the question in the stored transcript.

agent_color.description:
AgentColor is the palette key the dashboard draws this agent with. Omitted
keeps whatever the registry already holds, so a reconfigure never resets
a colour the user picked earlier.

agent.description: Agent renames the agent on restore. Empty keeps the archived name.

parent_run_id.description:
ParentRunID and ParentSpanID link a nested run (a subagent) into the
trace that started it.

tool_cost_usd.description:
ToolCostUSD is what the tool calls of this run cost at the configured
per-call prices. It is kept apart from ModelCostUSD on purpose.

trigger.description:
Trigger says what started the run: a user message ("user"), a cron job
("cron"), or a subagent ("subagent"). Heartbeats are not recorded.

BearerAuth.description: Token returned by POST /auth/login. Paste it with or without the "Bearer " prefix.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
